issues.body: `fb_distinct` means the `(repo, token)` pairs differ, not that the repositories differ. A supported configuration can therefore have `ALERT_REPO == REGISTRY_REPO` but `ALERT_TOKEN != REGISTRY_ALERT_TOKEN`. `_cmd_decide` then enumerates that same repository into `fallback_open`; after `_upsert_alert` successfully refreshes the firing issue on the primary route, the new branch calls `_close_superseded_alert` against the same repository and marker and closes that very issue. This erases the only live firing alert. The test fixes `priv_repo` and `reg_repo` to different values and therefore cannot catch the failure.
issues.fix_hint: Only perform superseded-copy closure when the normalized primary and fallback repository names are genuinely different; preserve the existing credential-fallback behavior separately. Add a test with the same repository and distinct tokens that starts with an open firing marker and proves the tick leaves it open and does not issue a close/comment.
issues.title: Same-repository fallback closes the only firing alert

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The supersede path is unsafe when the primary and fallback use the same repository with different credentials: it closes the live alert that the primary just refreshed. The new tests cover only distinct repositories, so they do not expose this supported route configuration.
